# elk-components

> React animation, layout, and styling toolkit with declarative motion, transitions, letter animations, and composable UI primitives with 205 built-in SVG icons.

## Overview

elk-components is a production-ready React component library powered by Motion and the Web Animations API. It provides:

- **Animation**: Dual-mode (Motion or Legacy Web Animations API) animation component with spring/tween transitions, hover/tap/scroll gestures, and layout animations
- **LetterAnimation**: Character-by-character text animations with 20 built-in presets (bounceIn, glitch, elastic, typewriter, wave, spiral, etc.)
- **Transition**: CSS-based enter/exit transitions with 20+ built-in types
- **Layout Components**: Container, Stack, Center, Section, Padding, Gap, Divider, Grid
- **UI Primitives**: Button, Text, Card, Badge, Avatar, Icon, Input, Tab, List, Tiles
- **Navigation**: Header, Navigator, BottomModal, SidePanel
- **Hooks**: useTheme, useBreakpoint, useMediaQuery, useReducedMotion, and more
- **Icons**: 205 built-in SVG icons organized by category

## Installation

```bash
npm install elk-components
```

## Quick Start

```tsx
import { Button, Text, Card, Animation } from "elk-components";

export default function App() {
  return (
    <Card padding="lg">
      <Animation
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        child={() => <Text text="Hello, elk-components!" type="h1" />}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## API Reference

### Components

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| [Animation](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=animation) | Dual-mode motion/legacy animation component |
| [LetterAnimation](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=letteranimation) | Character-by-character text animation |
| [Transition](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=transition) | CSS enter/exit transitions |
| [Button](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=button) | Customizable button with gesture support |
| [Text](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=text) | Typography component with semantic variants |
| [Card](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=card) | Container with glass morphism |
| [Badge](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=badge) | Status and label badges |
| [Avatar](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=avatar) | User avatar with presence indicator |
| [Icon](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=icon) | SVG icon component (205 icons) |
| [IconNetwork](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=iconnetwork) | Blockchain network icons |
| [Input](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=input) | Text input with validation |
| [Tab](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=tab) | Tab navigation component |
| [TabView](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=tabview) | Tabbed content panels |
| [List](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=list) | List container |
| [ListView](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=listview) | Scrollable list with virtualization |
| [Tiles](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=tiles) | Grid tile layout |
| [Container](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=container) | Responsive container |
| [Stack](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=stack) | Flexbox stack layout |
| [Center](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=center) | Centering layout |
| [Section](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=section) | Page section with divider |
| [Divider](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=divider) | Decorative dividers |
| [Image](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=image) | Image with loading states |
| [Span](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=span) | Inline layout wrapper |
| [Panel](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=panel) | Collapsible panel |
| [ScrollView](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=scrollview) | Custom scrollbar container |
| [Header](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=header) | App header/navbar |
| [Navigator](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=navigator) | Route navigator |
| [BottomModal](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=bottommodal) | Bottom sheet modal |
| [SidePanel](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=sidepanel) | Side panel overlay |
| [Padding](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=padding) | Padding utility |
| [Gap](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=gap) | Gap utility |

### Hooks

- [useTheme](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=hooks) — Access theme context
- [useBreakpoint](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=hooks) — Responsive breakpoint detection
- [useMediaQuery](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=hooks) — CSS media query matching
- [useReducedMotion](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=hooks) — Accessibility motion preference

### Icons

205 built-in SVG icons across categories: arrows, communication, devices, files, media, navigation, social, and more. See [Icons](https://elk-components.dev/docs?view=icons).
